Cached lists and thread headers avoid copying message bodies into JavaScript. IMAP sync keeps existing search terms when indexed content is unchanged. On Windows and macOS, routine mail credential reads and startup checks wait asynchronously, share pending reads and stop waiting after 30 seconds. Feature/status checks use guarded per-request grant snapshots; completed credentials are not cached globally. Read failures retain saved credentials. Account setup and credential writes keep synchronous compatibility commands bounded to 30 seconds per command. Search repair yields between saved batches. Exact local search chooses candidate access without dropping matches; broad ranking can still pause the host. Pending-body polls use an eligible-backlog index. Runtime IMAP body batches keep the 24-message limit, check a 32 ms elapsed budget and a 256 KiB normalized text/HTML budget, and yield only after durable commits. A single oversized message or disk call can exceed these targets. Body metadata preparation checks an 8 ms budget after each message and commits at most 64 rows before yielding; a single message or durable disk call may exceed that budget. Sync commits bounded message, flag and deletion batches, yielding with no open transaction; startup journal replay and initial checkpoints run in workers before mail admission. Tiny journals use a mailbox-size/copy-cost soft age instead of repeated minute-age copies, and a newly rotated journal keeps its own first-dirty time. Automatic work has separate one-hour age and large-backlog dispatch gates, but an owned worker, disk headroom or retry backoff can delay publication; these are not hard recovery-time limits. Explicit checkpoints still wait for their target sequence. Individual SQL, index and durable disk calls can still pause work. Durable acknowledgement, journal recovery and fsync are unchanged. Mail notifications route by mailbox, folder and visible surface, reuse supplied accounts and preserve unchanged readers. Unchanged folder trees retain their nodes and reuse folder lookups. Debug rows are retained and splitters batch writes per animation frame. MORROW_PERF=1 enables bounded local timings in Debug log every 30 seconds and fixed-label startup phase events, without mail contents or telemetry. Native Mac freezes still need profiling. Windows frame times have not been measured.
